description:
A repo's architecture in one call.

CALL THIS WHEN:
• You need a repo's overall structure, or which module owns something
• You don't know the repo's exact name in Pharaoh

RETURNS: Modules with file counts and LOC, module dependencies with two-way ones flagged, the files changed most in 90 days, and every endpoint with its handler file.

USE INSTEAD OF: directory listings, which omit dependency relationships.

repo.description: Repository name — one of your connected repos.

name: get_codebase_map
